The number of cases with TP2-1 (MTCT and maternal HBeAg-positive) is 141. 3. The number of cases with FN2-1 (MTCT and maternal HBeAg-negative) is not specified. 4. The number of cases with TN2-1 (No MTCT and maternal HBeAg-negative) is not specified. 5. The number of cases with FP2-1 (No MTCT and maternal HBeAg-positive) is not specified. 6. The sensitivity of maternal HBeAg in predicting MTCT is calculated as TP / (TP + FN). 7. The specificity of maternal HBeAg in predicting MTCT is calculated as TN / (TN + FP). 8. The outcomes in section 2-2 include the sensitivity and specificity of maternal high HBV DNA levels during pregnancy in predicting MTCT, but only for studies reporting MTCT as an endpoint. 9. MTCT is defined as the presence of infant HBsAg or HBV DNA, and the time period for this assessment is specified in the data. 10. Maternal HBV DNA is categorized as follows: i) For quantitative tests, a threshold is used to dichotomize viral load into high or low. ii) For qualitative tests, the limit of detection is used. 11. The number of cases with TP2-2 (MTCT and maternal high viral load) is not specified. 12. The number of cases with FN2-2 (MTCT and maternal low viral load) is not specified. 13. The number of cases with TN2-2 (No MTCT and maternal low viral load) is not specified. 14. The number of cases with FP2-2 (No MTCT and maternal high viral load) is not specified. 15.
